HTTP and MCP."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Pinakes"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A self-hosted knowledge service for AI agents: a wiki an LLM librarian keeps current, a business g"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"raph beside it, and one search entry that answers in milliseconds.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English · 简体中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Pinakes is named after the catalogue Callimachus wrote for the Library of Alexandria. It works
like "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"a library: the wiki is the collection, and an LLM acts as the **librarian** that files,
merges and c"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"hecks everything that comes in. It is built around two things."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 1. Retrieval in milliseconds"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The expensive thinking happens once, when knowledge is added (the
LLM wiki pattern): the
librarian w"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"rites the synthesis into pages ahead of time. So a read is only a lookup. **No
generative model and "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"no database query on the read path**: name matching, keyword search, graph
walks and, when the agent"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" asks, a vector search (whose only model is the small query encoder),
all over an in-memory snapshot"},{"id":"p7s5","text":". A classic RAG retriever is quick too, but it hands back raw
chunks that an LLM has to synthesize o"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"n every question; here that synthesis is already in the
pages, and the agent answers from them."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Measured on a laptop with 4 compute threads (medians; method and every number in

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Pinakes keeps three layers apart, and only the librarian writes the middle one:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Layer | What it is | Who writes it |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Raw sources | Task records, decision records, documents, schema definitions, preference notes; kep"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"t as they arrived, never changed | The agents and systems that call Pinakes |
| The wiki | Markdown "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"pages per kind and audience, linked to each other and anchored to graph entities | The librarian (an"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" LLM): it plans each change, writes it, and another step verifies it against the sources |
| Graph d"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ata | Nodes and edges in graph spaces, checked against their schema | The host system, or agents' dr"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"afts once a person approves them; never an LLM |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Knowledge comes in through **one entry per kind**, and goes out through **one search entry**:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Kind | Added with | Comes back in |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Agent experience: what worked, pitfalls and fixes | `/ingest/experience` | memories |
| User decis"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ions and their outcomes | `/ingest/decision` | memories |
| A decision, a lesson or both, as an agen"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"t recorded it (split by the librarian: decisions for the user, lessons for the team) | `/ingest/note"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"`, MCP `record_decision_or_lesson` | memories |
| User preferences | `/ingest/preference`, MCP `reco"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"rd_preference` | memories |
| Vertical expertise: documents and manuals | `/ingest/expertise` (JSON "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"or a file) | knowledge |
| The business graph: schemas, spaces, nodes, edges | `/ingest/graph/schema"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"`, `/space`, `/data` | knowledge (the schema's description) and relations (the edges) |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"A search (`/search`, MCP `search`) brings back three slots at once: **memories**, **knowledge**
and "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"**relations**. Each hit says how it matched and carries a route: read the page, open the
source it c"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ites, walk the graph from a node. The service returns signals, not decisions: the
agent chooses keyw"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ords or meaning, what to open and what to follow
(A-RAG), and writes the answer itself."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| | Classic RAG | Pinakes |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| When the thinking happens | on every question | once, when knowledge is added |
